No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. Three separate envelope boundaries retain capsule, cell wall and plasma membrane. Four pili meet the outer capsule and one flagellum crosses all three declared envelope boundaries. The nucleoid is an open noncountable DNA cue with fewer bends, not a nucleus; three enlarged ribosome markers are selected examples, not a natural particle count. Envelope bands are widened independently to 8 mm at the straight portions. No eukaryotic compartment is introduced.", "canvas_mm": [170, 180]}, "teaching": "Three separate envelope boundaries retain capsule, cell wall and plasma membrane. The nucleoid is an open noncountable DNA cue with fewer bends, not a nucleus; three enlarged ribosome markers are selected examples, not a natural particle count. Envelope bands are widened independently to 8 mm at the straight portions. No eukaryotic compartment is introduced.
